description_en: Synchronizes speech corpus in a combination speech broadcast device
description_zh: 调用该接口同步组合播报设备中的语料
name: SyncSpeechByCombination

parameters.help_en:
The device ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/280408.html to obtain this parameter.

If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is a globally unique identifier (GUID) of a device, which corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
设备ID，该参数可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/280408.html获取。

如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName
parameters.help_zh: 设备所属的产品ProductKey。如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The DeviceName of the device.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey
parameters.help_zh:
设备的DeviceName。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<notice>
If this ID value exists, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If this ID value does not exist, you do not need to specify it.

</notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。<props="china"><ph>您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。</ph></props>

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

<props="china">实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The audio format. Only wav, mp3, and amr formats are supported
parameters.name: audio_format

parameters.help_en:
The unique broadcast ID delivered to the device.
<notice>
If you do not specify this parameter, the system generates one. If you retry a broadcast at the business level, specify the broadcast ID of the retry to avoid duplicate business broadcasts.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
下发给设备的唯一播报ID。
<notice>
若不传入则由系统生成，若业务上进行重试播报，需传入重试的播报ID，避免出现重复业务播报。
</notice>
parameters.name: speech_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to deliver a forced broadcast flag to the broadcast device.

false (default): does not deliver
true: delivers
parameters.help_zh:
是否下发强制播报标识给播报设备。

false（默认）：不下发
true：下发
parameters.name: enforce_flag

parameters.help_en:
The combination broadcast content, which includes the following types:

To broadcast corpus that has been successfully pushed to the device, enter the identifier of the corpus.

To broadcast supported dynamic content, pass in the value based on the specific rules supported by the device.
    
    Example: Amount, in the format of `{$xxx}`, where xxx is the specific amount. For example, `{$1000}` causes the device to broadcast 1000 yuan.
    
The device broadcasts in the order of the delivered CombinationList
parameters.help_zh:
组合播报内容，包括以下类型：

播报已成功推送至设备中的语料，填入语料的标识。

播报支持的动态内容，根据设备支持的具体规则传入。
    
    示例：金额，格式为`{$xxx}`，xxx为具体的金额数，如`{$1000}`，则设备播报1000元。
    
设备根据下发的CombinationList进行顺序播报
parameters.name: combination_list

DeviceErrorMessage.description_zh: 设备播报返回错误信息

Id.description_zh: 下发给设备的唯一播报ID，即请求的参数SpeechId，若不传入则由系统生成

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

true：调用成功。
